description: List the 70+ World Bank data sources (datasets), such as World Development Indicators, International Debt Statistics, and Doing Business. Returns source IDs and names for use as source_id in worldbank_search_indicators, worldbank_get_data, and worldbank_list_countries, one page at a time.

per_page.description: Results per page (default: server default). Positive integers above 100 are served at that maximum with the requested and served sizes echoed and a notice. totalPages uses the served size.

name: worldbank_list_sources

appliedFilters.description: The page size served, and the size asked for when it was reduced.

perPage.description: Results per page actually served — the requested size or server default, reduced to the page cap when larger. totalPages is counted at this size.

requestedPerPage.description: Page size asked for, requested or server default, present only when it exceeded the page cap and perPage was reduced.

currentPage.description: Page number requested — past totalPages when the request ran off the end.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Context for an empty page — the page range that exists when the requested page is past the end — or for a page size reduced to the page cap.

sources.description: World Bank data sources for this page.

items.description: A World Bank data source entry.

concepts.description: Number of concepts (variables) in this source.

id.description: Source ID for use in worldbank_search_indicators, worldbank_get_data, and worldbank_list_countries.

lastUpdated.description: Date of last data update (YYYY-MM-DD or empty).

title: List World Bank Data Sources
